none.$description: Squared. Data tables, code blocks, image containers, dense form grids — never rounded regardless of system personality.

sm.$description: Chips / badges, tooltips, small inline controls.

md.$description: Interactive tier: buttons (all variants share this tier), inputs, selects, textareas. The signature rounded-rectangle (deliberately not full-pill).

xl.$description: Prominent containers: modals / dialogs, large feature cards, the intake form panel.

full.$description: Genuinely circular/pill elements only: avatars, decorative dots, the marquee band. NOT default buttons or CTAs.

sm.$description: Default borders and dividers (cards, inputs at rest).

focus.$description: Focus ring width (rendered as outline, offset 2px, color = border-focus).

sm.$description: Cards at rest. Two-layer, violet-tinted ink (from #1A1830) — never pure black.

md.$description: Raised / hover state (lifted cards, primary buttons). Two-layer violet-tinted ink.

lg.$description: Overlays / dialogs. Two-layer violet-tinted ink; separates surface-overlay from the page.
